entry.en: The passport must be valid for at least 30 days after leaving South Africa and have at least 2 blank pages.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe ser válido al menos 30 días después de salir de Sudáfrica y tener al menos 2 páginas en blanco.
entry.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 30 days after the date you leave South Africa and have at least 2 blank pages.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si se viene de un país listado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter South Africa, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: From 1 July 2026, all travellers entering or leaving South Africa must submit an online traveller declaration before travelling.
entry.es: Desde el 1 de julio de 2026, todos los viajeros que entren o salgan de Sudáfrica deben presentar una declaración de viajero en línea antes de viajar.
entry.quote: From 1 July 2026, all travellers entering or leaving South Africa through air, land, sea and rail ports of entry are required to submit an online traveller declaration before travelling.

entry.en: You must declare cash of more than 25,000 South African rand per person when entering.
entry.es: Al entrar hay que declarar el efectivo superior a 25.000 rand sudafricanos por persona.
entry.quote: When you enter South Africa, you must declare cash if you are bringing: more than 25,000 South African rand per person

entry.en: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty, as the rules on goods are strict.
entry.es: Hay que declarar todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles, pues las reglas sobre mercancías son estrictas.
entry.quote: There are strict rules about goods you can take into or out of South Africa. You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

entry.en: Have a return ticket available or you may be sent back.
entry.es: Ten un billete de regreso disponible o podrían devolverte.
entry.quote: Make sure you have a return ticket available or they will send you back.

safety.en: There are regular protests and demonstrations that can turn violent at short notice.
safety.es: Hay protestas y manifestaciones frecuentes que pueden volverse violentas con poco aviso.
safety.quote: There are regular protests and demonstrations in South Africa which can turn violent at short notice.

safety.en: Violent crime can take place anywhere, including in tourist destinations and transport hubs.
safety.es: El crimen violento puede ocurrir en cualquier lugar, incluidos destinos turísticos y nudos de transporte.
safety.quote: Violent crime can take place anywhere, including in tourist destinations and transport hubs.

safety.en: Criminals have followed people from OR Tambo airport in Johannesburg to their destinations and robbed them, often at gunpoint.
safety.es: Delincuentes han seguido a personas desde el aeropuerto OR Tambo de Johannesburgo hasta su destino y las han robado, a menudo a punta de pistola.
safety.quote: Criminals have followed people from OR Tambo International Airport in Johannesburg to their destinations and then robbed them, often at gunpoint.

safety.en: Criminals may pose as police using blue lights on plain vehicles to stop motorists and steal the vehicle.
safety.es: Delincuentes pueden hacerse pasar por policías con luces azules en vehículos comunes para detener a conductores y robarles el vehículo.
safety.quote: Criminals may pose as police and use ‘blue lights’ on plain (often white) vehicles to stop motorists and steal the vehicle.

safety.en: There have been recent violent attacks and muggings against hikers and tourists in Table Mountain National Park.
safety.es: Ha habido ataques violentos y atracos recientes contra excursionistas y turistas en el Parque Nacional de Table Mountain.
safety.quote: There have been recent violent attacks and muggings against hikers and foreign tourists in Table Mountain National Park, including on Lion’s Head and Signal Hill.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in South Africa.
safety.es: Es probable que terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Sudáfrica.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in South Africa.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of South Africa, including Johannesburg.
health.es: La enfermedad de altura es un riesgo en partes de Sudáfrica, incluida Johannesburgo.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of South Africa, including Johannesburg.

health.en: South Africa has very high standard private medical care, which can be expensive, so travel health insurance is needed.
health.es: Sudáfrica tiene atención médica privada de muy alto nivel, que puede ser cara, por lo que se necesita seguro médico de viaje.
health.quote: South Africa has a very high standard of private medical care. Private healthcare can be expensive, so make sure you have the right travel health insurance

health.en: It is best to avoid public hospitals where possible, and private hospitals are of world class standard.
health.es: Lo mejor es evitar los hospitales públicos si es posible, y los privados son de nivel mundial.
health.quote: It is best to avoid public hospitals where possible. Private hospitals are of world class standard.

health.en: Municipal tap water is usually safe to drink throughout the country.
health.es: El agua del grifo municipal suele ser potable en todo el país.
health.quote: Municipal tap water is usually safe to drink throughout the country.

health.en: The north-eastern areas, including Kruger National Park, are seasonal malaria zones from about November to May.
health.es: Las zonas del noreste, incluido el Parque Nacional Kruger, son zonas de malaria estacional de noviembre a mayo aproximadamente.
health.quote: The north-eastern areas of the country (including the Kruger National Park and St. Lucia and surrounds) are seasonal malaria zones, from about November to May.

health.en: HIV is a risk in South Africa, so normal precautions to avoid exposure are advised.
health.es: El VIH es un riesgo en Sudáfrica, por lo que se aconsejan las precauciones normales para evitar la exposición.
health.quote: HIV is a risk in South Africa. Take normal precautions to avoid exposure to HIV/AIDS.

help.en: The all-emergencies number from mobiles is 112, ambulance and fire is 10177 and police is 10111.
help.es: El número de emergencias desde móviles es el 112, ambulancia y bomberos el 10177 y policía el 10111.
help.quote:
All emergencies from mobiles: 112

Ambulance and fire: 10177

Police: 10111

help.en: The National Sea Rescue Institute can be reached on 112 or +27 87 094 9774.
help.es: Al Instituto Nacional de Rescate Marítimo se le puede llamar al 112 o al +27 87 094 9774.
help.quote: National Sea and Rescue Institute: 112 or +27 87 094 9774

help.en: Wilderness Search and Rescue can be reached on +27 21 937 0300.
help.es: El servicio de búsqueda y rescate en zonas salvajes atiende en el +27 21 937 0300.

help.en: The National Tourism Information and Safety Line is +27 83 123 2345 (mobile).
help.es: La línea nacional de información y seguridad turística es el +27 83 123 2345 (móvil).
help.quote: The National Tourism Information and Safety Line, ☏ +27 83 123 2345 (mobile).

getting_in.en: South Africa has 10 international airports, with O.R. Tambo in Johannesburg as the primary intercontinental hub and Cape Town International as the secondary one.
getting_in.es: Sudáfrica tiene 10 aeropuertos internacionales; el principal nudo intercontinental es O.R. Tambo en Johannesburgo y el secundario Ciudad del Cabo.
getting_in.quote: South Africa has 10 international airports. The primary intercontinental hub is the O.R. Tambo International Airport in Johannesburg; the secondary one is Cape Town International.

getting_in.en: O.R. Tambo has direct flights from major European centres, the Middle East, Asia, a few U.S. cities, Brazil and Australia.
getting_in.es: O.R. Tambo tiene vuelos directos desde grandes centros europeos, Oriente Medio, Asia, algunas ciudades de EE. UU., Brasil y Australia.
getting_in.quote: O.R. Tambo International Airport has direct flights from major European centres, the Middle East, Asia, a few U.S. cities, Brazil, and Australia.

getting_in.en: Durban International Airport is the third biggest airport, with regular flights from cities in Africa.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de Durban es el tercero más grande, con vuelos regulares desde ciudades de África.
getting_in.quote: Durban International Airport is the third biggest airport with regular flights from cities in Africa.

getting_in.en: From other Southern African countries you can enter by car through a number of land border posts.
getting_in.es: Desde otros países del sur de África se puede entrar en coche por varios pasos fronterizos terrestres.
getting_in.quote: Should you be entering from one of the other countries in Southern Africa you might want to do so by car. South Africa operates a number of land border posts between itself and immediately neighboring countries.

getting_around.en: South Africa has well-established domestic air travel with links between all major centres.
getting_around.es: Sudáfrica tiene una red de vuelos nacionales bien establecida que une todos los grandes centros.
getting_around.quote: South Africa has a well-established domestic air travel infrastructure with links between all major centres.

getting_around.en: Scheduled bus services run between all the big cities and to neighbouring countries.
getting_around.es: Hay autobuses regulares entre todas las grandes ciudades y hacia países vecinos.
getting_around.quote: There are scheduled bus services between all the big cities (with stops in between), as well as connections to neighbouring countries.

getting_around.en: The Baz Bus offers a hop-on-hop-off service on tourist routes such as Cape Town to Port Elizabeth via the Garden Route.
getting_around.es: El Baz Bus ofrece un servicio de subir y bajar en rutas turísticas como Ciudad del Cabo a Port Elizabeth por la Garden Route.
getting_around.quote: An alternative is the Baz Bus . It offers a regular hop-on-hop-off service on some of the most interesting routes for the tourist (Cape Town to Port Elizabeth via the Garden Route).

getting_around.en: Minibus taxis are poorly maintained and rarely comply with safety standards.
getting_around.es: Los minibuses taxi están mal mantenidos y rara vez cumplen las normas de seguridad.
getting_around.quote: If you're really in a pinch, you can use minibus taxis. They are poorly maintained and rarely comply with safety standards.

getting_around.en: As of December 2025 only two Shosholoza Meyl train routes operate, with less than one departure monthly.
getting_around.es: En diciembre de 2025 solo operan dos rutas de tren Shosholoza Meyl, con menos de una salida al mes.
getting_around.quote: as of December 2025, only two routes are now operated by Shosholoza Meyl (Johannesburg-Durban and Johannesburg-East London) and trains are not frequent (less than a departure monthly).

getting_around.en: In most cases speed limits are 120km/h on highways and 60km/h on major roads.
getting_around.es: En la mayoría de los casos los límites de velocidad son 120 km/h en autopistas y 60 km/h en carreteras principales.
getting_around.quote: In most cases, speed limits are 120km/h for highways and 60km/h on major roads.

money.en: The currency is the rand (ZAR), divided into 100 cents.
money.es: La moneda es el rand (ZAR), dividido en 100 centavos.
money.quote: The currency is the rand, denoted by the symbol "R" (ISO code: ZAR). It is divided into 100 cents (c).

money.en: Credit cards are the primary way of making purchases and some businesses will not accept cash.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito son la forma principal de pagar y algunos negocios no aceptan efectivo.
money.quote: Having a credit card is important in South Africa, as they are the primary way of making purchases in South Africa.  Some businesses will not accept payment in cash.

money.en: Visa and MasterCard are accepted almost everywhere.
money.es: Visa y MasterCard se aceptan casi en todas partes.
money.quote: Credit cards from Visa and MasterCard are accepted almost everywhere.

money.en: It is best to use only ATMs that are inside a mall or other building.
money.es: Lo mejor es usar solo cajeros automáticos dentro de un centro comercial u otro edificio.
money.quote: It is best to use only ATMs that are inside a mall or other building.

money.en: VAT is levied at 15% on almost all products.
money.es: El IVA es del 15 % en casi todos los productos.
money.quote: VAT (Value Added Tax) is levied at 15% on almost all products in South Africa.

money.en: Prices in shops are fixed, but prices in open markets or from street vendors are open to barter.
money.es: Los precios en tiendas son fijos, pero en mercados abiertos o con vendedores ambulantes se puede regatear.
money.quote: Prices in shops are fixed, but prices in open markets or from street vendors are open to barter.

etiquette.en: South Africans are generally polite, friendly and accommodating to tourists.
etiquette.es: Los sudafricanos suelen ser educados, amables y acogedores con los turistas.
etiquette.quote: South Africans are generally polite, friendly and accommodating to tourists.

etiquette.en: Men generally greet with a firm handshake, while women do the continental kiss on the cheek.
etiquette.es: Los hombres suelen saludar con un apretón de manos firme y las mujeres con un beso en la mejilla al estilo continental.
etiquette.quote: Men generally greet with a firm handshake, while women will do the continental kiss on the cheek.

etiquette.en: Same-sex displays of affection may draw unwelcome attention, though they are tolerated in more gay-friendly areas of Johannesburg.
etiquette.es: Las muestras de afecto entre personas del mismo sexo pueden generar atención no deseada, aunque se toleran en zonas más abiertas de Johannesburgo.
etiquette.quote: Homosexual displays of affection may generate unwelcome attention although they will be tolerated and respected in the more gay-friendly and cosmopolitan areas of Johannesburg (Sandton, Rosebank and Parkhurst)

etiquette.en: Nude sunbathing is illegal except at designated beaches.
etiquette.es: Tomar el sol desnudo es ilegal salvo en playas designadas.
etiquette.quote: Except for designated beaches, nude sunbathing is illegal, although topless sunbathing for women is acceptable along Durban and Umhlanga beaches, and Cape Town's Clifton and Camps Bay beaches.

etiquette.en: It is wise to avoid racial or political remarks without a good understanding of South African history.
etiquette.es: Conviene evitar comentarios raciales o políticos sin un buen conocimiento de la historia sudafricana.
etiquette.quote: It is wise to avoid racial or political remarks while in South Africa if you don't have a good understanding of South African history

etiquette.en: Calling somebody Dutch can be taken as an insult, and the term Boer is considered pejorative.
etiquette.es: Llamar holandés a alguien puede tomarse como un insulto, y el término bóer se considera peyorativo.
etiquette.quote: Calling somebody Dutch, for example, can be taken as an insult. Also the term Boer is considered pejorative.

connectivity.en: There are five cell phone providers: Vodacom, MTN, Cell C, Virgin Mobile and Telkom.
connectivity.es: Hay cinco operadores móviles: Vodacom, MTN, Cell C, Virgin Mobile y Telkom.
connectivity.quote: There are five cell phone providers in South Africa: Vodacom, MTN, Cell C, Virgin Mobile and Telkom.

connectivity.en: A prepaid SIM needs a passport and proof of residential address and must be registered before calling.
connectivity.es: Una SIM de prepago requiere pasaporte y comprobante de domicilio y debe registrarse antes de usarla para llamar.
connectivity.quote: You will need a passport and a proof of residential address and it has to be registered before you can call or receive calls.

connectivity.en: With a passport and driver's licence at a Vodacom or MTN store you can be connected on the spot.
connectivity.es: Con pasaporte y licencia de conducir en una tienda Vodacom o MTN puedes quedar conectado en el momento.
connectivity.quote: If you call into a Vodacom or MTN store with a passport and drivers licence, you can be all connected on the spot.

connectivity.en: Mobile network and data costs are generally not very cheap.
connectivity.es: Los costos de red móvil y datos en general no son muy baratos.
connectivity.quote: Generally, mobile network and data costs are not very cheap.
